exact_statement: Let C be the restriction-closed class of all finite disjoint products of point signs f_m=1-2*1[x=0], bent pairs (-1)^(uv), characters and constants. Every f in C satisfies G(f)<=(19/8)I(f), with the stronger per-coordinate guard Delta_i U<=(19/8)Inf_i. On every finite fair adaptive physical restriction tree in C, V_t=(19/8)I(f_t)-U(f_t) is nonnegative, initially <=(19/8)I(f), and a supermartingale; its exact predictable drop is (19/8)Inf_(i_t)-Delta_(i_t)U. Terminal U remains paid by the SAME original influence budget, and V plus its accumulated drops is a martingale. Nevertheless, for m>=3, take N=2^(m-1) disjoint point_m factors g_m and F_m=(-1)^(uv)g_m in C. ANY supporting original reference and ANY account paying terminal KL and actual outcome KL that admits immediate v-query, actual-product reset of both children and stopping must have Account/I(F_m)>=(m^2-5m-2)/(m+1), unbounded. Full terminal H or U only strengthens that obstruction. These same sources have H(F_m)<=4I(F_m). Thus a valid hereditary GU bound and a paid nonnegative physical U-process do NOT imply cheap capital for ALL product stopping cuts, for any reference choice. Universal GU and FEI remain open.
